title: /agentic-framework:update command to update the plugin from a project
description: There is no first-class command to update the agentic-framework plugin from within a project — users must remember the raw `claude plugin update agentic-framework` CLI. Add a commands/update.md slash command (distributed via the plugin, like apply-workflows.md) that explains and runs the plugin update, and points the user at /agentic-framework:apply-workflows afterward so an already-initialized project picks up any newly-shipped workflows. Pure markdown command file — no src/ code. Mirror the structure and tone of commands/apply-workflows.md.
acceptance_criteria: commands/update.md exists with YAML frontmatter (description) and is auto-discovered as /agentic-framework:update.
The command body instructs the agent to run `claude plugin update agentic-framework` (via the Bash tool) and to relay the CLI's result to the user.

The command notes the post-update follow-ups: run /agentic-framework:apply-workflows to retrofit new workflow files into an already-initialized project (and references that the framework self-updates artifacts on next init where applicable).
The command is human-friendly for a non-technical operator (plain language, no internal jargon), consistent with the existing command docs.
Any command-count or command-manifest test (if one exists) is updated so the suite passes; npm run test:changed plus any affected e2e specs are green.
